text: Security is a crucial part of web development. One of the first steps is using HTTPS, which encrypts data between the user and the server. Authentication also matters: it makes sure that only the right people can access protected areas, usually through passwords or two-factor methods. Another key practice is input validation, which checks what users type into forms to stop harmful code from entering the system. Developers must also learn about common vulnerabilities, such as SQL injection and cross-site scripting, and follow best practices to prevent them. By taking these steps, developers can build safer websites and protect users' personal information.
